sources.title: GitHub - jaredlcs/lunarlander-ppo
sources.snippet: This project trains an AI agent to land a lunar module safely using PPO (Proximal Policy Optimization), a state-of-the-art reinforcement learning algorithm. The agent learns by trial and error, controlling thrusters to achieve soft landings.

sources.title: lunar_lander_ppo.ipynb - Colab
sources.snippet: Companion notebook for the Intro to Reinforcement Learning workshop. We use the Stable-Baselines3 implementation of PPO (Proximal Policy Optimization) to train an agent that lands a spacecraft on the moon. Runtime tip: for PPO with an MLP policy, CPU is actually faster than GPU (the policy net is tiny and the bottleneck is environment stepping). The default Colab CPU runtime is fine.
